title: Disjoint synthetic validation of history semantics-by-surface association in persona-conditioned dialogue choice

scientific_scope.question: On new synthetic personas and dialogue-like cases, does an archived recommendation surface frame alter current persona-consistent choice more than a declarative record, conditional on aligned, conflicting, or decision-irrelevant archived content?
scientific_scope.claim_boundary: Independent synthetic validation of a surface association only. It is not real-speaker validation, a full S/F/H factorial study, causal identification of history in a population, human-validated Persona Fidelity, or algorithm validation.
scientific_scope.development_independence: No case, target, persona, or exact task-template material is reused from the two bound prior 12-case banks. The model, runtime, broad controlled-choice paradigm, and output-informed scientific question are inherited and disclosed.
scientific_scope.unit: One synthetic persona-case crossed with seven within-case arms.

prompt_policy.fixed_system_instruction: Answer as the specified synthetic speaker. Use exactly two sentences. Sentence one must be exactly 'Option A [<exact A anchor>] — <exact A name>.' or 'Option B [<exact B anchor>] — <exact B name>.' Sentence two must briefly justify the choice using the current evidence and the speaker's stated style. Do not choose an archived alternative.
prompt_policy.history_user_template: Earlier, for a different situation, the speaker considered: {history_choices}. Which one did the speaker choose then?
prompt_policy.history_user_template_rule: The controller must construct history_choices as the semicolon-plus-space join of all three opaque-anchor/entity pairs in archived_semantic_display_order and must generate the archived user turn only by formatting history_user_template.
prompt_policy.aligned_reason_template: That matched my preference for {trait} during that earlier exchange.
prompt_policy.conflict_reason_template: That contradicted my preference for {trait} during that earlier exchange.
prompt_policy.irrelevant_reason_template: That handled a separate practical concern during that unrelated earlier exchange.
prompt_policy.surface_pair_isolation: Within each semantic condition, raw and declarative archived assistant messages differ only in the first-sentence frame; their second sentence is byte-identical.
prompt_policy.semantic_package_isolation: Across H semantics, the archived user turn and its three listed entities are identical; only the selected target-plus-reason assistant package changes. No archived dialogue is present in SF_NO_H.
prompt_policy.irrelevant_policy: The decision-irrelevant history selects the case's unique unrelated third target and uses a statement whose whitespace-token length differs by at most two words from the aligned and conflict statements.
prompt_policy.anchor_policy: Current alternatives retain A/B anchors. Archived alternatives receive opaque H1/H2/H3 anchors solely from frozen display position; the anchor never encodes aligned, conflict, or irrelevant semantics. The scorer binds opaque anchor to entity identity through the protected frozen case mapping.
prompt_policy.speech_act_and_tokenization_package: The RAW versus DECLARATIVE manipulation intentionally changes first-sentence speech act and surface tokenization together while preserving its selected entity and a byte-identical second sentence. It estimates this bundled frame association and does not identify a pure pragmatic or pure tokenization cause.

allocation_and_order.case_order: The immutable case execution_index 0..23 in the case bank.
allocation_and_order.within_case_order: Literal 24-row near-Williams first-order-balanced schedule in the v3 controller. All rows are unique; each arm-position count is 3 or 4; among the 42 directed non-self predecessor pairs, 24 occur three times and 18 occur four times.

balance_requirements.counterbalance_cells: 6 archived semantic-role permutations x preferred identity {A,B} x preferred current display position {FIRST,SECOND}

evaluation_policy.surface_robust_selection_rule: Inspect only the certified first response span and its first sentence, never excluded raw tail. preferred_current_anchor_selection is one iff exactly one case anchor is present and it is the preferred current anchor; any_current_anchor_selection is one iff exactly one case anchor is present and it is either current anchor. MULTIPLE and NONE are complete-denominator zeros for assessable responses. Empty, unidentifiable, or TRUNCATED units remain missing and receive logical bounds. Exact option label plus anchor plus name is a consistency diagnostic.

response_assessability.rule: A response is assessable only when the boundary classifier certifies a nonempty identifiable first unit and status is not TRUNCATED.
response_assessability.CROSS_TURN: Assess only the certified first span and discard the continuation tail from every automatic endpoint.
response_assessability.AMBIGUOUS: Assess only when unit_identifiable is true; ambiguity concerns semantic completeness, which is not inferred automatically.
response_assessability.TRUNCATED: Always missing/boundary-censored; never score the partial span.
response_assessability.empty_or_suspicious: Missing whenever the classifier cannot certify an identifiable first unit.

partial_execution_analysis.planned_slot_policy: Every integrity audit and analysis materializes all 168 registered request slots. Archived derived results are used directly; append-only raw responses with recoverable derivation are reconstructed; attempted-unresolved and unattempted slots remain explicit None values.
partial_execution_analysis.missingness: Missing primary outcomes are never recoded as zero. Every binary summary and paired contrast reports resolved denominators plus logical worst/best bounds.
partial_execution_analysis.sensitivity: Report case-paired estimates, task-family strata, and leave-one-persona-out ranges when estimable; retain bounds even when no complete case remains.

derived_contrast.theta_A_minus_theta_C: theta_A - theta_C; the only prospectively derived primary contrast.

estimands.endpoint_application: Compute every registered estimand separately for preferred_current_anchor_selection and any_current_anchor_selection.
estimands.uncertainty: Report case-level paired estimates, logical missing-outcome bounds, task-family strata, and persona leave-one-out ranges. No p-values are registered.

primary_endpoint.name: human_preferred_current_entity_selection
primary_endpoint.coding: COMPLETED selected_entity matching the protected case preferred current option=1; other current option, OTHER_ENTITY, NONE or MULTIPLE=0; UNAVAILABLE or UNCERTAIN=missing.

stage_a.secondary_numeric_reporting: Report original-scale means and the complete 1,2,3,4,5 distribution for every 1-to-5 field; UNCERTAIN and UNAVAILABLE remain missing for the numeric endpoint and are reported separately.

secondary_binary.human_any_current_entity_selection: CURRENT_OPTION_A or CURRENT_OPTION_B=1; OTHER_ENTITY, NONE or MULTIPLE=0; UNCERTAIN/UNAVAILABLE=missing.

stage_a.categorical_rule: Report planned, completed, unavailable and every registered category count/proportion by arm. Do not construct an ordinal or scalar contrast for these fields.
stage_a.secondary_contrasts: Apply all seven common_arm_contrasts separately to every registered numeric, normalized ordinal and binary secondary endpoint; they remain descriptive secondary estimates.

preferred_current_entity_selection.coding: COMPLETED side selected_entity matching the protected case preferred current option=1; the other current option, ARCHIVED_ENTITY, OTHER_ENTITY, NONE or MULTIPLE=0; UNCERTAIN/UNAVAILABLE=missing.

any_current_entity_selection.coding: COMPLETED side selected_entity CURRENT_OPTION_A or CURRENT_OPTION_B=1; ARCHIVED_ENTITY, OTHER_ENTITY, NONE or MULTIPLE=0; UNCERTAIN/UNAVAILABLE=missing.

conflict_resolution.coding: Only CONFLICT: FAILED=0, PARTIAL=0.5, RESOLVED_FOR_CURRENT=1; NO_CONFLICT_TO_RESOLVE/UNCERTAIN/UNAVAILABLE=missing and separately counted.

stage_b.conflict_resolution_contrast: Only SFH_CONFLICT_DECLARATIVE minus SFH_CONFLICT_RAW is identifiable and registered for the numeric conflict_resolution endpoint; report the full conflict_resolution category counts for every semantics/surface cell and do not apply aligned/irrelevant common contrasts to structurally inapplicable values.
stage_b.pairwise_coding: After protected unblinding: DECLARATIVE chosen=+1, RAW chosen=-1, TIE=0, BOTH_UNACCEPTABLE=0 with a separate both-unacceptable indicator; UNCERTAIN/UNAVAILABLE=missing.
stage_b.both_unacceptable_indicator: BOTH_UNACCEPTABLE=1; DECLARATIVE choice, RAW choice or TIE=0; UNCERTAIN/UNAVAILABLE=missing.
stage_b.pairwise_reporting: For each endpoint and semantics report DECLARATIVE/RAW/TIE/BOTH_UNACCEPTABLE/UNCERTAIN/UNAVAILABLE counts and mean signed score. Registered contrasts are pooled surface=(ALIGNED+CONFLICT+IRRELEVANT)/3, ALIGNED-minus-IRRELEVANT, and CONFLICT-minus-IRRELEVANT.

missing_and_bounds.rule: Never recode UNAVAILABLE, UNCERTAIN, structural inapplicability, or missing generation as zero. For each summary report planned N, observed N, missing N and observed estimate.
missing_and_bounds.linear_contrast_rule: For each planned unit and coefficient w, observed contributes w*y; missing contributes lower=min(w*L,w*U) and upper=max(w*L,w*U); average over all planned units.
missing_and_bounds.sensitivity: Also report complete-case estimate/count, task-family strata, and leave-one-persona-out range when estimable.

human_estimands.stopping_and_claims: Stage A has exactly 168 assigned records and Stage B exactly 72 pairs; no outcome-based early stop, replacement or supplemental labeling. Analyze each stage once after its sealed intake. A single PI provides genuine descriptive human evidence but not independent validation or IRR. Ordinal means are descriptive. No real-speaker, broad Persona Fidelity, population-causal, algorithm, or confirmatory claim is supported.

bindings.material_lineage: V3 reuses the unchanged V2 case bank and material-disjointness audit by exact SHA-256. V2 had zero model and human-review operations, so this prospective reuse does not expose outcomes or alter case selection.

stopping_rules: Stop before any model launch unless a separate exact authorization, immutable native-token manifest, and passing official preflight exist.
Attempt each of the 168 frozen requests at most once, in frozen order, with zero retries and zero hidden warmups.
Abort before the next request if the inference-seconds or batch-wall ceiling would be exceeded.
Preserve partial append-only evidence after any failure; never restart or silently fill missing rows.
Do not create human labels automatically or reveal the mapping before valid blinded intake.
known_limitations: The single-model study cannot establish cross-model generality.
Synthetic personas cannot establish real-speaker Persona Fidelity.
All history conditions are executed in one future batch, but NO_H versus H still bundles context length and additional entities.
Exact label/name choice is a constrained behavioral endpoint and does not by itself establish semantic quality.
RAW versus DECLARATIVE bundles speech act and tokenization differences; the registered surface estimand is not a pure causal decomposition.
The question was motivated by earlier outputs, although every case, target, persona, and exact template here is new.
No validated original algorithm is tested. Raw and declarative history are simple prompting baselines.
